display_long_description:
Climb a living tree all the way to the clouds. Throw magical seeds, look at the exact spot where you want branches to grow, and shape nature itself with your eyes. Dodge hazards, react to unexpected events, and collect special fruits that alter how your seeds behave.

This experience blends immersive physical climbing with innovative gaze-based interaction, creating a unique connection between player and environment.

FEATURES
- Gaze-based branch creation powered by eye-tracking
- Immersive physical climbing mechanics
- Magical seeds with unique growth effects
- Dynamic environmental hazards (breaking branches, small dragons)
- Special fruit pickups that modify gameplay behavior


WHAT DOES THE PROJECT INCLUDE?
- One immersive vertical level
- Two types of magical seeds
- One fruit type that alters seed behavior


The demo showcases the core mechanics of gaze-controlled growth and physical VR climbing, offering a glimpse into a new way of interacting with virtual worlds - through sight, movement, and discovery.
